translations.web: Who is this King of glory? Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory!
translations.bsb: Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts— He is the King of Glory. Selah
translations.kjv: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
translations.asv: Who is this King of glory? Jehovah of hosts, He is the King of glory. Selah Psalm 25 A Psalm of David.
